target_customer: Patients with complex, overlapping chronic illness (Long COVID, ME/CFS, MCAS, POTS) who pay for clinic membership, prescriptions and testing
problem: People with infection-associated chronic conditions struggle to find clinicians who understand overlapping conditions, and their health data is scattered.
business_model: Free data intelligence platform plus paid clinic membership (reported $1,000 per month with 3 month minimum and $1,500 onboarding), prescriptions and lab testing; cash pay, no Medicare or Medicaid
product_category: Digital clinic for complex chronic illness

founders.name: Ryan Kellogg
education: PhD in Microfluidics and Systems Biology, ETH Zurich
founders.background_notes: YC page says he developed technology for measuring thousands of molecules in self-collected blood microsamples after his own struggle with a mystery illness. Employers not listed. Source: YC company page.

founders.name: Jennifer Curtin
founders.background_notes: Physician treating post-viral illness and ME/CFS for over five years and Long COVID for the past year at the time of the YC page; member of the ME/CFS Clinician Coalition and co-author of 2021 Mayo Clinic Proceedings ME/CFS guidance. Source: YC company page and rthm.com.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs a clinical care delivery layer with licensed clinicians and a data platform that unifies patient records and lab results; standard software but with clinical and regulatory overhead. Founder had microfluidic blood microsample technology background per YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical know-how from a physician founder and accumulated patient data could help, but care delivery and software were copyable and no regulatory moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing incumbents building or buying the same Long COVID and ME/CFS wedge in 2022; the company remained active per the YC directory.

market_need_then: Long COVID created a large new population of patients with unmet needs in early 2022; YC page claims 70M US individuals are affected by infection-associated chronic and autoimmune conditions (company figure, not independently checked).

branding.name_origin: Stands for Real Time Health Monitoring and is pronounced rhythm (one directory and a search summary); no founder interview confirming this was opened.
branding.domain_note: Operates on rthm.com, an exact abbreviation domain; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: not described by any source opened
identity.visual_style: clinical wellness web style with navigation across Intelligence, Clinic and Direct products
identity.voice_and_tone: Empathetic, patient-first language about conditions that have no home in traditional healthcare

brand_strength.rationale: Niche condition-specific brand with no found press on the brand itself; name is confusable with Honeywell RTHMS and a vowel-less spelling.

outcome_analysis: RTHM is active as of the directory and built from founders with lived and clinical experience of Long COVID and ME/CFS, which gives it founder market fit. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reporting was found in an outcome search. Funding is not reliably documented, so the trajectory beyond a small team of 10 and a widening product line from intelligence platform to clinic and direct prescriptions cannot be judged.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists $2.0M seed (May 2022), Dealroom lists seed entries of $1.6M, $2.0M and $125k, Village lists $4.1M total, a Substack guide says $6.1M, and one snippet says $1M pre-seed. All come from aggregators or secondary posts, so none is recorded as a round. Do not confuse with RTHMS (a different company). Competitors: a Sifted article from Nov 2022 names Visible (London, $1M raise) and HealthHero, but that is about 8 months after the batch, so none are listed as of founding. Company site lists Jennifer Curtin as the only named cofounder while the YC page lists Ryan Kellogg as CEO. Completeness pass: the seed round of $2.0M (May 2022) is recorded and rests on a single database (VCBacked); Seedtable dates the last funding 2022-03 with no amount, and other aggregator totals conflict, so the real total is unknown. Not confused with Rithmm.
